pages.text: “Blooming hibiscus brings a fleeting moment of sweetness and healing.”$(br2)Hibiscus Tea is a vibrant and slightly sour drink made from dried hibiscus petals and sugar. Drinking it grants an Instant Health effect, allowing travelers to quickly recover lost health.
$(br2)$(br)To prepare Hibiscus Tea, $(br)boil dried hibiscus petals with sugar.$(br)It is perfect for emergency situations, rapidly restoring health and helping travelers continue their journey.

Upon drinking Hibiscus Tea, travelers gain an Instant Health effect, immediately restoring health.$(br)This tea is ideal for emergency recovery.$(br)If JEI is installed, press R while hovering over the icon to view the recipe.
